Drug-target-pathway-disease network diagrams and distribution of core targets in the main pathways

Drug-target-pathway-disease network diagrams and distribution of core targets in the main pathways. a Drug-target-pathway-disease network diagram for the effect of propofol against FSD. b Diagrams of the estrogen signaling pathway, highlighting the target that is common to both propofol and FSD, represented in red color
